chunks: And the Shaykh, may Allah the Exalted support him, informed me; he said: Abu al-Qasim Ja'far ibn Muhammad informed me, from Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from Yunus, who said:
One who saw Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام at Mina informed me that he was wiping the upper part of his feet from the top of the foot to the ankle, and from the ankle to the top of the foot.
And the explanation of this hadith has already passed.

key_terms.أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Abu al-Hasan, the Imam عليه السلام mentioned in the report
key_terms.بِمِنًى: at Mina, the location where the Imam عليه السلام was seen
key_terms.ظَهْرَ قَدَمَيْهِ: the upper part of his two feet
key_terms.يَمْسَحُ: he was wiping, referring to the act of masḥ in wudu (ablution)

ai.seo_question: How did Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام wipe his feet in wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a description of how Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام performed the wiping of the feet in wudu (ablution). It is relevant to the jurisprudence of ritual purity and indicates the manner of wiping over the upper part of the feet.
